calls.statement:
WITH sold_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.sale_date, cp.subcategory, f.net_amount, f.quantity
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s     ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p   ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN dim_product cp  ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
    JOIN dim_date d      ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_quarter = 1
      AND cp.category = 'Garden' AND cp.subcategory <> 'Outdoor Lighting'
),
refunds AS (
    SELECT sales_line_id, SUM(refund_net) AS refund_net, SUM(quantity_returned) AS qty_ret, MAX(return_date) AS last_return FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT l.subcategory,
       ROUND(SUM(l.net_amount),2) AS sold_net,
       ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net), 0),2) AS returned_net,
       ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net), 0) / SUM(l.net_amount), 2) AS return_rate_pct,
       count(*) n, count(r.sales_line_id) nret, min(l.net_amount) minnet, sum(CASE WHEN r.qty_ret>l.quantity THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) overqty,
       sum(CASE WHEN r.refund_net<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) negref, max(r.last_return) lastret
FROM sold_lines l LEFT JOIN refunds r USING (sales_line_id)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
